newsitem.title: USA: Aquagenix sees FY 1997 revs doubling with deal.
newsitem.headline: Aquagenix sees FY 1997 revs doubling with deal.

text.p: Aquagenix Inc said Tuesday it signed a five-year agreement with a major utility provider to offer services worth up to $30 million.

The company said it would provide forestry management and other services to the provider within Southern Co's electric system. It said it would do most of its work within the transmission and distribution line right of ways and hundreds of power substations and large tracts of woodlands owned by the utility.
Aquagenix said the deal could boost revenues to over $20 million for fiscal 1997 from $11.5 million the previous year.
"This contract is the most significant marketing development since Aquagenix's formation in 1993," it said, adding it will begin as early as April 15 on the contract.
Based in Fort Lauderdale, Aquagenix clears brush and trees from utility projects like power lines in rural areas, among other things.
